fieldNotes.truckGate: 2025-02 Street View shows the north dock court opening directly onto Glenfield Ave with no barrier, booth, or checkpoint — Google's camera shoots straight into the court (trailers at doors, tractor parked). Chain-link frontage has open driveway gaps; parked-open slide gates may exist for after-hours closure but there is no active control.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: North-face docks are one truck-length off the public street; trucks set up for backing from Glenfield Ave itself, and any queue sits on the street.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~12 doors on the north face (NE court), ~15-18 on the east face, a few on the south drive; 30 estimated.
fieldNotes.dropArea: West yard holds scattered trailer rows (~30) plus NW-corner rows along the frontage; band 25-50.
fieldNotes.railServed: An overgrown tree-lined rail spur corridor forms the SW boundary and dead-ends near the west yard — historic spur, no active track into the property visible.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: A single 'Shipping/Receiving' directional sign at the west drive suggests one combined check-in flow despite two dock faces.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Three independent open accesses: west-yard drive, north dock court, east apron street access.
